# Rollout notes

## Summary

Fixed the seeded in-place restart race by invalidating and clearing any delayed
held-key movement before `GameManager` replaces the board. This prevents input
scheduled against the previous board from advancing a newly restarted board,
while retaining the existing delayed repeat behavior for ordinary held
directional keys.

Because Space, the Try again button, and Game API restart/reset operations all
call `GameManager.restart`, the fix applies consistently to every required
restart path.

## Source inspected

- `js/keyboard_input_manager.js`
- `js/game_manager.js`
- `js/html_actuator.js`
- `js/grid.js`
- `js/application.js`
- `game_api.js`
- `index.html`

## Source changed

- `js/keyboard_input_manager.js`
  - Added `cancelPendingMove()` to invalidate the callback serial and clear the
    outstanding timeout.
  - Reused the helper from directional keyup handling.
- `js/game_manager.js`
  - Calls `inputManager.cancelPendingMove()` before restarting the actuator and
    creating the new grid.

## Checks run

- `node --check js/keyboard_input_manager.js`
- `node --check js/game_manager.js`
- `node --check game_api.js`
- `git diff --check`
- Protected-browser check: held `ArrowUp+Space` for 500 ms; the restarted board
  remained at two tiles with score 0 after the old repeat deadline.
- Protected-browser check: held `ArrowLeft` for 500 ms during ordinary play;
  the existing delayed repeat still occurred, resulting in two moves.
- `npm run build` was attempted as requested, but this workspace has no
  `package.json`, so npm exited with `ENOENT`.

## Relevant observations

- The delayed move callback is guarded by a serial token, so incrementing the
